title: Chesapeake Utilities Corporation and Subsidiary Florida City Gas Commit $500,000 to Rockledge Department of Safety to Enhance First Responder Training and Strengthen Regional Safety
summary: DOVER, Del. — Chesapeake Utilities Corporation (NYSE: CPK) and its subsidiary Florida City Gas announced a $500,000 sponsorship commitment to support the Rockledge Department of Safety Regional Training Center, reinforcing their shared commitment to safety, emergency preparedness and ongoing community engagement across Florida’s Space Coast.
